title: std::optional divide
prompt: Implement `std::optional<int> safe_divide(int a, int b)`: return the quotient when `b != 0`, and `std::nullopt` when `b == 0`. No exceptions, no sentinel ints.

tests.name: zero
tests.hint: Division by zero is absence, not zero.

tests.name: negative
tests.hint: Negatives follow the same truncation rule.
